mathar-recurrence.scope: This explicitly isolated recurrence clause of source Theorem 1 is exactly public result after unfolding claim: forall n : Nat, 6 <= n -> the six sequence terms plus 24(12n-47) equal zero. T uses natural subtraction followed by +1; on 0 <= k <= n, t >= 5, so it equals the manuscript t-4. Polynomial coefficients are natural and all recurrence arithmetic is cast to integers. Since n >= 6, shifts n-1 through n-5 have no truncated subtraction. This row does not claim the full conjunction or the n=5 extension.
